question: Should gogcli accept a narrowly scoped Drive API v2 dependency for `--if-version` conditional replacements when Drive v3 does not expose the ETag needed for the proposed atomic precondition?
rationale: This is a new public CLI capability whose long-term API-support boundary cannot be inferred from tests or automated review.

options.title: Accept the isolated v2 bridge
options.body: Allow the opt-in conditional path to use Drive v2 while ordinary uploads and unconditional replacement remain on Drive v3.

options.title: Defer until a v3-only mechanism exists
options.body: Do not add the flag until gogcli can provide the same atomic guarantee without adding Drive v2 support.

options.title: Choose a different public contract
options.body: Ask for a revised concurrency-control interface if the version-and-ETag design is not the intended long-term CLI API.

recommendation.title: Accept the isolated v2 bridge
recommendation.body: Allow the opt-in conditional path to use Drive v2 while ordinary uploads and unconditional replacement remain on Drive v3.

likelyOwner.reason: Best available owner signal for repository-level API and Drive command direction.
